# Umeed Care Center

> Umeed Care Center is a leading orthotic and prosthetic clinic in Karachi, Pakistan, providing expert care to patients of all ages. "Umeed" means hope — and restoring mobility and independence is the foundation of everything we do.

## About

Umeed Care Center offers a complete range of orthotic and prosthetic services under one roof. Our certified prosthetists and orthotists deliver compassionate, personalized care tailored to each patient's unique needs.

## Services

- **Lower Limb Prosthetics** — Custom prosthetic legs and feet for patients with lower limb amputation
- **Upper Limb Prosthetics** — Functional prosthetic arms and hands for daily independence
- **Pediatric Orthotics & Prosthetics** — Specialist solutions designed for children's growing bodies
- **Spinal Orthotics** — Back braces and spinal supports for scoliosis and spinal conditions
- **Lower Limb Orthotics** — Ankle-foot orthoses (AFO), knee braces, and full-leg supports (HKAFO)
- **Upper Limb Orthotics** — Wrist splints, elbow braces, and dynamic hand orthoses
- **Custom Foot Orthotics** — Precision insoles and arch supports tailored to individual feet
- **Diabetic & Pressure-Relief Footwear** — Specialist sandals and shoes for diabetic patients in Karachi
